{{Quote|You know, I never knew that serving under an Ithorian commander would be so hard on the hearing!|Ryenne complains after Truno bellows at an Imperial|<ref name="AORC" />}}
'''Truno''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Special Operations]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the war, he was involved in a [[Mission to Sunfall Peak|mission]] on a [[Unidentified backwater planet|backwater]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to destroy a [[Imperial communications hub]] located there. He lead [[Team Bantha]] on a diversionary attack against the local [[Imperial administration center]] before heading to the hub in an stolen Imperial shuttle to recover the [[Team Thumper|team]] sabotaging it.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I've got this. Just be ready to fire when I say so.|Ryenne tells Truno to take control of the shuttle|<ref name="AORC" />}}
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] Truno served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Special Operations]] division of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During a mission to sabotage a [[Imperial communications hub]] on a [[Unidentified backwater planet|backwater]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Truno was made commander of [[Team Bantha]], whose objective was to create a diversion by attacking an [[Imperial administration center]]. During the attack, the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] Team [[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]] was using was destroyed on arrival, and so Truno and his [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ryenne]] stole an Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to escape. Truno and Ryenne then headed for [[Sunfall Peak]], where the hub was located, to pick up [[Team Thumper]], the team assigned to sabotage the hub. En route however, an [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Sunfall Peak)|Imperial officer]] still onboard the shuttle attacked the pilot, causing the ship to partially collide with a canyon wall.<ref name="AORC" />

Truno managed to pull off the Imperial and subdue him by bellowing at him with one of his four mouths, although sustaining a wound to the mouth in the process. The Ithorian then attended to the damage done by the canyon wall, fixing the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] but being unable to repair the [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizer]]. Agent [[Corvan]] of Team Thumper then contacted Truno and Ryenne, and they tried made a plan as to how to recover Team Bantha. Upon reaching the hub, Ryenne left the shuttle, handing over controls to Truno, and managed to open a jammed [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] that was trapping the other Rebel team. Once Team Thumper was free, the Lieutenant opened fire on the pursuing Imperials while the other Rebels boarded the stolen shuttle. Once onboard the group saw a pair of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] in low orbit releasing [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], and Corvano revealed the shuttle that Truno and Ryenne had stolen belonged to the local [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Sunfall Peak)|Imperial governor]] and so contained valuable intelligence.<ref name="AORC" />

On another occasion the members of Team Bantha and Team Thumper managed to steal data from an Imperial base by downloading it onto a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. Once the data they needed had been taken, the console they were using was destroyed and the Rebels fled, encountering two sentries on their way to the nearest landing pad, who they then fought.<ref name="AORC" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I've got the shields back online, but the stabilizer is hopeless. At least we made it out.|Truno reports back on trying to repair the stolen shuttle|<ref name="AORC" />}}
Truno was a tall and lanky Ithorian, who had some experience in starship repair.<ref name="AORC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Truno first appeared in the opening short narrative of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]]. He was also later used as a player's character in an example of gameplay given later in the book.
